description: Track cryptocurrency prices and markets with CoinLore's free public data. Price one coin or fifty at once, list the largest coins by market cap, see the day's biggest gainers and losers, look up what a project is and where its coin trades, and check the market as a whole. Coins are chosen by name from a list, and every figure comes back in US dollars. No account or API key is required.
